zh.title: 澳洲運輸安全局報告：澳洲航空A380維修後機翼遺留工作燈並執飛兩航段
zh.summary: 澳洲運輸安全局指澳洲航空A380機翼遺留工作燈執飛兩國際航段，未造成損害。
body: 澳洲運輸安全局（ATSB）於2026年8月17日發布代號為 AO-2026-004 的最終調查報告，指出澳洲航空（Qantas）一架空中巴士（Airbus）A380客機在維修期間，機翼內部被遺留了一具可攜式維修工作燈。該架客機在未發現遺留工具的情況下，隨後執行了兩個國際長程航段，最終安全返回雪梨。
根據調查報告，涉事客機為機身編號 VH-OQK 的空中巴士 A380-842。該機於2026年1月7日從洛杉磯國際機場（LAX）飛抵雪梨機場（SYD），隨後在雪梨進行空調系統維修，工程人員進入左側機翼內部區域更換空氣生成單元的出口溫度感測器，並使用工作燈照明。然而，在維修工作完成後，維修人員未能於外物清除檢查中發現該燈具，後續的工具歸還及班次結束檢查亦未能發現異常。
儘管工作燈尚未歸還，一名授權飛機維修工程師仍簽發了適航放行證書。該客機隨後於1月7日晚些時候從雪梨起飛，執行前往達拉斯/沃斯堡國際機場（DFW）的航班，並於1月8日抵達達拉斯。在達拉斯期間由外部維修機構進行維修時，該燈具同樣未被發現。隨後，該機執行 QF8 班機返回雪梨，並於1月9日清晨降落雪梨機場。
該起事件於1月9日上午被發現，澳洲航空工具房工作人員審視未歸還工具報告時，注意到兩天前借出的工作燈尚未歸還。經搜尋後，維修人員在左翼空氣生成單元熱交換器附近尋獲該工作燈。ATSB 表示，此事件未造成結構損壞、系統干擾或人員受傷，但暴露出外物控制與工具管理流程上的失誤。

en.title: ATSB Report Finds Qantas A380 Flew Two Sectors With Maintenance Light in Wing
en.summary: ATSB reports Qantas Airbus A380 flew two international flights with a maintenance light left inside its wing.
body: The Australian Transport Safety Bureau (ATSB) released its final investigation report (AO-2026-004) on August 17, 2026, revealing that a maintenance work light was left inside the left wing of a Qantas Airbus A380 during scheduled work at Sydney Airport (SYD). The aircraft subsequently operated two long-haul international passenger flights before the tool was discovered and recovered.

The aircraft involved, an Airbus A380-842 registered VH-OQK, arrived at Sydney Airport from Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) on January 7, 2026. Maintenance engineers performed work on its air conditioning system, accessing an internal compartment of the left wing to replace an outlet temperature sensor on an Air Generation Unit. A portable work light was brought inside to illuminate the workspace. Following the maintenance, engineers performed foreign object clearance inspections but failed to detect the light left inside the wing. Subsequent tool return procedures and end-of-shift checks also failed to identify the missing tool.

Despite the unreturned tool, a licensed aircraft maintenance engineer issued a certificate of release to service, allowing the aircraft to return to operation. The A380 departed Sydney later on January 7 bound for Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW), arriving on January 8. External maintenance personnel at Dallas/Fort Worth performed further work on the aircraft, but the maintenance lamp again went undetected. The aircraft then operated return flight QF8 back to Sydney, landing at 06:55 on January 9.

The missing light was identified later that morning when a Qantas tool crib operator reviewed equipment records and noticed that a work light issued for VH-OQK two days earlier had not been returned. Maintenance personnel initiated a search and located the lamp near the Air Generation Unit heat exchanger inside the left wing. The ATSB confirmed that the aircraft sustained no structural damage, and no system disruptions or injuries occurred during the flight sectors.

zh.title: 愛爾蘭航空2026年停飛5條美國航線重組航網
zh.summary: 愛爾蘭航空於2026年裁撤5條美國航線；因載客率低迷與競爭加劇調整航網
body: 愛爾蘭航空（Aer Lingus）已決定於2026年正式裁撤5條美國航線。根據 Simple Flying 報導，此項決策主要是受到載客率持續低迷、市場競爭日趨激烈以及營運利潤空間縮減等多重因素影嚮。
面對這些營運挑戰，愛爾蘭航空選擇透過削減部分效益較低的美國航線來推動航網絡重組。此舉旨在應對當前的市場競爭環境，並重新調整營運布局。
報導指出，載客量不足與利潤率下滑使得原本的航線布局面臨調整壓力，推動航空公司採取網絡重組措施以應對未來的營運需求。

en.title: Aer Lingus Cuts 5 US Routes in 2026 Amid Low Passenger Demand and Competition
en.summary: Aer Lingus cuts five US routes in 2026 following weak loads, rising competition, and lower margins.
body: Aer Lingus has announced plans to cut five US routes in 2026. According to a report by Simple Flying, the airline is restructuring its route network in response to challenging operational conditions across its US service portfolio.

The route cuts are being driven by a combination of weak passenger loads, increasing competition, and shrinking profit margins. These factors have forced Aer Lingus to re-evaluate its current network strategy and reset its service offerings.
By removing five US routes from its schedule for 2026, Aer Lingus aims to adapt to the competitive market environment and improve overall network efficiency.
